scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana

identifiers.target_group: First-time employees and eligible employers

authority.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
authority.ministry_department: Ministry of Labour and Employment

classification.target_group: First-time employees and eligible employers

benefit.benefit_description: Provides a one-time incentive of up to Rs. 15,000 to eligible first-time employees and incentives to eligible employers for additional employment.

description.summary: Provides employment-linked incentives to encourage formal job creation and support first-time employees.
description.short: Employment-linked incentive for new formal workers.
description.full: PM-VBRY is an employment-linked incentive scheme intended to promote job creation, formalisation of employment and expansion of social security coverage. The registration period for jobs covered by the scheme runs from 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2027.

conditions: Employment must satisfy the scheme's registration and EPFO-related conditions.

faqs.question: How much can a first-time employee receive?
faqs.answer: An eligible first-time employee can receive an incentive of up to Rs. 15,000.

faqs.question: How long is the registration period?
faqs.answer: Jobs created during the registration period from 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2027 are covered, subject to the scheme conditions.

source.source_reference: PIB and Ministry of Labour & Employment official PM-VBRY information ([Press Information Bureau][1])

verification.verification_note: Current implementation and benefit disbursement were verified through official Government of India releases.
